desc:
This game is made for fun so dont take anything too seriously..
-------------
a uncanny game version of Mafioso, whose wandering around seeking to find people in debt, Just don’t get near him.. or you will pay the price..

joke game obviously, dont expect everything to be accurate lol.

*Controls*:
Sprint (PC) - Left Shift
Emote (PC) - G Key
Shift lock (PC) - Left or Right Control
Emote (Console) - D-pad Down Arrow
Shift lock (Console) - B/Circle Button
Sprint (Console) - L2 Button
Mobile players have a button!
